stories.text: 🪦 The eulogy is in: In My Fantasy Era gets its send-off (15.39 pts short). Read it on the Death Watch tab, and bring tissues.
🎯 PLAYOFF SWING: Ruffing the Passer vs Mr. Action Jackson. Playoff odds with a win / loss: Ruffing the Passer 45% / 19%, Mr. Action Jackson 87% / 66%.
🎯 TWO WINS: Ruffing the Passer: 48% playoff odds with 2 wins this week, 15% with none (now 35%).
🔁 Trade that should have happened: Robinson and Williams for LaPorta and London back in Week 1 would have helped both TDsMaGee and Claremont In Yo Stace!.
🪓 DEATH WATCH: Mel's Mediocre Mob leads the chopping-block odds at 57%, with Uriel's Upbeat Team next at 25%.
🛒 WAIVER WIRE MVP: Ramosverse's pickups have put 307.62 pts into its starting lineup this season, led by McLaughlin (78.00 pts) and Stroud (73.12 pts).
🥊 Heavyweight bout: #2 Kyle Tucker (5–3) meets #3 Claremont In Yo Stace! (6–2).
🤝 Rivalry week: Gibb it to Me Baby leads The Mahomies 4–3 all-time.
🔥 Beautiful Dark Twisted Fantasy has won 5 straight. 49er Faith-Fool gets the next crack at them.
🎤 BYE BYE BYE: The Mahomies has 2 starters on bye this week (Metcalf and Boswell). Somebody call *NSYNC.
🕰️ Hindsight swap: If Kyle Tucker and Brock You Like a Hurricane had swapped Smith-Njigba for Walker and Burden back in Week 2, both would be ahead.
🗞️ Fresh off the wire: TDsMaGee added Kirk Cousins (QB, projected 15.16 pts), plus 2 more pickups.
📈 Beautiful Dark Twisted Fantasy was down to 11% against Gibb it to Me Baby — and won.
💓 Ruffing the Passer outlasted The Mahomies after the favorite flipped 5 times.
